mapper.select:
SELECT p.post_id AS id, p.title AS title, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment c WHERE c.company_id = p.company_id AND c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS commentCount
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.post_id AS id, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, p.author_employee_id AS authorId, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, CASE WHEN p.updated_at > p.created_at + INTERVAL '1' SECOND THEN TO_CHAR(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS updatedAt FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.company_id = p.company_id AND b.board_id = p.board_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.post_id = #{postId} AND b.board_type = 'BOARD_ANON' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visible_yn = 'Y'

SELECT p.post_id FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.company_id = p.company_id AND b.board_id = p.board_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.post_id = #{postId} AND b.board_type = 'BOARD_ANON' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visible_yn = 'Y' FOR UPDATE OF p.post_id
SELECT MIN(board_id) FROM board WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND board_type = 'BOARD_ANON' AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (company_id, board_name, board_type) VALUES (#{companyId}, '익명 게시판', 'BOARD_ANON')

INSERT INTO post (post_id, company_id, board_id, author_employee_id, title, content, status_code) VALUES (#{postId}, #{companyId}, #{boardId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, 'POST_PUBLISHED')
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE post SET deleted_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP), status_code = 'POST_REMOVED'
mapper.select: SELECT c.post_comment_id AS id, c.content AS text, c.author_employee_id AS authorId, TO_CHAR(c.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM post_comment c WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at, c.post_comment_id
